title: Anoop Baranwal v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Anoop Baranwal v. Union of India, (2023) 6 SCC 161
content.holding: 5-judge Constitution Bench held that independent ECI is part of the basic structure; directed appointments of CEC and ECs by a committee of PM, LoP, and CJI until Parliament legislated.
content.relevance: Benchmark ruling on appointment independence of Election Commission.
